relation: one top-level outcome depends on an ordered chain of adjacent support layers, where each layer requires the layer immediately beneath it and the foundation enables the chain bottom-up

stageEvents.observable: the top outcome is readable while the supporting layers remain visibly present but inactive
a single trace descends from the target through every adjacent dependency in order
the bottom foundation becomes the first confirmed support and no upper layer is yet marked ready
support advances upward one adjacent layer at a time from the foundation
all four layers are active and the top outcome becomes ready only after the chain reaches it
the completed stack holds with the full foundation-to-outcome dependency path traceable

limits: exactly four ordered layers plus one named foundation
each non-foundation layer depends only on the immediately adjacent layer beneath it
dependency is traced top-down before support is activated bottom-up
the target resolves only after every support layer is active
no branching, cross-layer shortcut, containment claim, cycle, weighted influence, or parallel execution
vertical order expresses supplied dependency only and does not imply chronology, ownership, physical containment, or relative importance
